# Skill: Kit SDK Tools with `repo kit_tools`

## When to Use

Use this skill when the user works with Kit-based applications or extensions. This toolkit provides commands for pulling extensions, packaging apps, building containers, bumping versions, validating APIs, profiling, and more.

## Overview of Commands

repo_kit_tools registers **10 commands**. Most are disabled by default and must be enabled in `repo.toml`.

| Command | Default | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| `repo pull_extensions` | disabled | Pull Kit kernel and extensions from registry |
| `repo pull_app` | disabled | Pull a packaged Kit app from Packman |
| `repo package_app` | disabled | Package a Kit app for Launcher or standalone distribution |
| `repo package_container` | disabled | Package a Kit app into a Docker container with layer caching |
| `repo launch` | disabled | Interactive launcher for local Kit apps or containers |
| `repo kit_autoupdate` | enabled | Auto-update Kit SDK version, bump app versions, generate changelogs |
| `repo bump` | enabled | Interactively bump extension/app versions with changelog |
| `repo checkapi` | disabled | Validate public Python API surface of Kit extensions |
| `repo tracetools` | enabled | Open and convert Tracy profiler trace files |
| `repo stage_for_github` | disabled | Strip internal content and stage repo for public GitHub release |

Enable a command in `repo.toml`:
```toml
[repo_kit_pull_extensions]
enabled = true
```

## Commands in Detail

### `repo pull_extensions` -- Pull Kit Extensions

Pulls the Kit kernel and required extensions using Packman and extension registries.

```bash
repo pull_extensions                    # Pull with default registry
repo pull_extensions --registry public  # Specify registry type
repo pull_extensions setup              # Generate precache config
```

Configuration:
```toml
[repo_kit_pull_extensions]
enabled = true
packman_files_to_pull = ["${root}/deps/kit-sdk.packman.xml"]
registry_default = "public"

[repo_kit_pull_extensions.registries]
public = [
    { name = "kit/default", url = "${registry_url}/exts/${registry_name}/${registry_shared_name}" },
]
```

### `repo pull_app` -- Pull Packaged App

One-time pull of a pre-built Kit app from Packman.

```bash
repo pull_app -c release
```

### `repo package_app` -- Package Kit App

Packages a Kit app ready for Launcher or standalone use.

```bash
repo package_app -c release            # Full package
repo package_app --thin -c release     # Thin package (downloads deps at runtime)
repo package_app -n "my-app"           # Custom package name
```

### `repo package_container` -- Docker Container Packaging

Packages a Kit app into a Docker container with two-layer caching (base: kernel + cached extensions; app: application).

```bash
repo package_container --app my_app.kit
repo package_container --app my_app.kit --image-tag latest
repo package_container --generate ./containers  # Generate template Dockerfile
repo package_container --extra-ext omni.some.ext
```

Configuration:
```toml
[repo_kit_package_container]
enabled = true

[[repo_kit_package_container.container]]
kit_app = "my_app.kit"
name = "my-app"
dockerfile = "${root}/source/containers/Dockerfile"
entrypoint = "${root}/source/containers/entrypoint.sh"
```

### `repo launch` -- Interactive App Launcher

Discovers and launches local Kit apps or Docker containers.

```bash
repo launch                            # Interactive menu
repo launch -n my_app.kit              # Launch specific app
repo launch --container                # Launch Docker container (Linux)
repo launch -p path/to/archive.7z     # Launch from packaged archive
repo launch my_app -- --enable omni.ext  # Pass args to Kit
```

### `repo kit_autoupdate` -- SDK Auto-Update (CI)

Automatically updates Kit SDK version, bumps app versions, updates extensions, generates changelogs, and commits. Primarily used in CI.

```bash
repo kit_autoupdate                     # Full update cycle
repo kit_autoupdate update              # Update only (skip version bump/changelog)
repo kit_autoupdate release             # Release only (version bump + changelog)
repo kit_autoupdate --kit-version 107.0 # Update to specific Kit version
repo kit_autoupdate --skip-build        # Skip build step
```

Configuration:
```toml
[repo_kit_autoupdate]
kit_package_name = "kit-sdk"
version_file = "${root}/VERSION.md"
build_command = ["${root}/build${shell_ext}", "-r"]
write_changelog.enabled = true

# Per-branch overrides
[repo_kit_autoupdate."git_branch:daily"]
branch_to_merge = "master"
```

### `repo bump` -- Version Bumping

Interactive tool to bump extension/app versions with optional changelog entries.

```bash
repo bump                              # Interactive selection
repo bump "omni.kit.*"                 # Pre-filter by name pattern
```

Walks through: select extension → choose bump type (patch/minor/major) → optional changelog → confirm.

Configuration:
```toml
[repo_bump]
ext_folders = ["${root}/source/extensions", "${root}/source/apps"]
```

### `repo checkapi` -- API Validation

Validates the public Python API surface of Kit extensions. Generates `config/python_api.md` for each extension and checks that imports only reference public APIs.

```bash
repo checkapi                          # Full check (generate + validate)
repo checkapi -sg                      # Skip generation, check only
repo checkapi -sc                      # Generate only, skip check
repo checkapi -f "omni.kit."          # Filter to specific namespace
repo checkapi --strict                 # Warnings for all missing modules
repo checkapi --output-json            # JSON output
```

Configuration:
```toml
[repo_checkapi]
enabled = true

[repo_checkapi.python]
exts.folders = ["${root}/_build/${platform}/${config}/exts"]
exts.exclude = ["omni.example.*"]
fail_on_changed_api = true
```

### `repo tracetools` -- Tracy Profiler

Opens and converts trace files for the Tracy profiler.

```bash
repo tracetools tracy path/to/trace.gz     # Auto-convert and open
repo tracetools tracy trace.json           # Convert JSON to Tracy format
repo tracetools tracy trace.tracy          # Open directly
repo tracetools tracy trace.gz -w          # Overwrite existing conversions
```

Supports automatic format conversion chain: `.gz` → `.json` → `.tracy`.

### `repo stage_for_github` -- GitHub Staging

Strips internal-only content and stages a repo for public GitHub release.

```bash
repo stage_for_github /path/to/staging
repo stage_for_github /path/to/staging --dry-run
```

Configuration:
```toml
[repo_stage_for_github]
enabled = true
github_repo_url = "https://github.com/NVIDIA-Omniverse/my-repo.git"
exclude = ["tools/ci/*", "internal/*"]

# Trim content between markers
[[repo_stage_for_github.trim]]
files = ["**/*.py"]
begin_marker = "# INTERNAL BEGIN"
end_marker = "# INTERNAL END"

# Merge TOML patches (e.g., replace internal URLs)
[[repo_stage_for_github.toml_merge]]
source_file = "repo.toml"
patch_file = "github/repo.toml.patch"
destination_file = "repo.toml"
```

## Extension Registry Configuration

Kit extensions are pulled from registries. Environments can be configured for different deployment stages:

```toml
[[repo_kit_pull_extensions.environment]]
name = "prod"
app_version_regex = ".*-prod"
tokens.registry_url = "https://extensions.example.com"
tokens.registry_shared_name = "shared"

[[repo_kit_pull_extensions.environment]]
name = "staging"
tokens.registry_url = "omniverse://kit-extensions.example.com"
```

## Typical Kit App repo.toml

```toml
[repo_kit_pull_extensions]
enabled = true
packman_files_to_pull = ["${root}/deps/kit-sdk.packman.xml"]

[repo_kit_package_container]
enabled = true

[repo_launch]
enabled = true

[repo_checkapi]
enabled = true

[repo_bump]
ext_folders = ["${root}/source/extensions", "${root}/source/apps"]
```
